title: Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches: a memory flaw attackers can abuse
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 145 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched.

category.label: Routers, cameras and devices
category.why: Routers, cameras and recorders are often forgotten and rarely updated.
category.doThis: Update it or replace it. Never leave its admin page open to the internet.

summary: Zyxel GS1900 series switches contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the CGI program which could allow a LAN-based, unauthenticated attacker to exploit the flaw and potentially execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Sep 24, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.

evidence.title: Patched Zyxel GS1900 switches remained open to in-the-wild exploit (CVE-2026-107441)
